A New York Times item indexed by Techmeme says SpaceX is renting computing power to competitors, including Anthropic, while sources describe Musk telling employees its own AI effort is falling behind. The excerpt frames a tradeoff between rental income and capacity devoted to improving internal products.

The primary article timed out, so the underlying sources, allocation figures, timing and company response were not inspected. A reported internal assessment is not an independently measured model ranking, and a claim about relative rental economics does not establish total profitability or abandonment of internal AI. This summary stays within the feed excerpt rather than reconstructing unavailable evidence.
highlights: NYT feed describes compute rental to competitors
Anthropic is named in the excerpt
An internal assessment is attributed to sources
Capacity allocation and economics were not independently checked
No product abandonment or objective model ranking is established
